name: kit-safety
description: A safety net for risky commands: saves a snapshot of what a command would delete or overwrite, asks you in plain language before it runs, restores everything in one step with /safety restore, and hides well-known API keys and passwords in what Claude reads.

confirm.title: When to ask before a risky action
confirm.description: risky: ask in plain words before a command that deletes, overwrites or rewrites history (rm -r, git push --force, git reset --hard, ...) or before overwriting a .env file; edits to other files Git does not track are only saved quietly. always: also ask before overwriting any file Git does not track. never: never ask. Every choice still saves a snapshot first (except when cleaning up something large that can be rebuilt).

maskSecrets.title: Mask secrets in tool output
maskSecrets.description: Replace well-known key shapes (Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, AWS and Stripe keys, private keys, JWTs, passwords in URLs) with sk-ant-•••• masked in what Claude reads, in the stored message and on your screen. Only well-known shapes are recognised. Turn off to see and store output unchanged.

keepSnapshots.title: Snapshots to keep per project
keepSnapshots.description: The newest snapshots kept for each project (quiet saves of edited files and the ones you were asked about count together; quiet ones go first); older ones are deleted. Whole number from 1 to 200; a value outside that range is cut to it.

keepDays.title: Days to keep a snapshot
keepDays.description: A snapshot older than this is deleted, in every project, when a session starts. Whole number from 1 to 90; a value outside that range is cut to it.

maxSizeMB.title: Largest snapshot (MB)
maxSizeMB.description: A call that would touch more than this (or more than 50,000 files) is not snapshotted; the confirmation says so and still asks. Whole number from 10 to 2000; a value outside that range is cut to it.

maxTotalMB.title: Largest total of all snapshots (MB)
maxTotalMB.description: All snapshots of all projects together may take this much disk space; the oldest are deleted first when a session starts. Whole number from 100 to 20000; a value outside that range is cut to it.

language.title: Language of the band and /safety
language.description: auto: Vietnamese when Claude Code's own language setting is Vietnamese, English otherwise (looked up once at session start). en: always English. vi: always Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt). What Claude itself reads stays English.
